symptom: Invisible typewriter text on accent gradient lines
root_cause: Parent bg-clip:text with transparent color was not inherited by inline-block typeword/character spans, plus unstyled intermediate span broke CSS inherit and 1ms duration caused floating point step-end cutoff

symptom: Sequence timing broken for multi-line hero title animations
root_cause: Each line calculated its own sequence gap rather than accumulating duration of preceding lines, causing line 1 to animate at 90ms while line 0 typewriter was still typing

symptom: Cold start browser init / Playwright measurement discrepancy
root_cause: Playwright cold start browser process initialization skewed first route measurement to 1640ms; verified warm FCP on mobile is ~140ms across engines

symptom: Mobile nav menu Services item uses in-page scroll rather than landing links
root_cause: On home page, Services scrolls to #services section; service cards link to modal, whereas landings are in footer
